title: The Sarsa Crossing Splits the Guru’s Family

blocks.text: At the Sarsa the crossing erupts into chaos: people are split in two directions, goods are lost, and neither families nor followers can keep formation once the flood and attack break the line. (44–46)
The elder Sahibzadas remain with the Guru while the younger are separated with Mata Gujri, and the situation is compared to older epic scenes of divine flight and battlefield confusion. (47–49)
Beyond the river stand the Ropar Pathans, former beneficiaries of the Guru’s favor, whose coming betrayal is foreshadowed as the exhausted survivors move toward them. (51–52)
